therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: glucose-dependent insulin secretion and glycemic regulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (Cohort 2) and healthy participants (Cohort 1)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: pharmacokinetic parameters (AUC, Cmax, Tmax) and safety/tolerability

results.effect_size: HbA1c LS mean difference -0.95% (95% CI: -1.50 to -0.40); FPG LS mean difference -40.4 mg/dL (95% CI: -66.5 to -14.3)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma exenatide concentrations measured by validated ELISA; AUC (0-8h) 125.6 pg*h/mL and AUC (0-Week 12) 147220.2 pg*h/mL for 10 mg single dose; AUC (0-168h) at steady state 49100.2 pg*h/mL for 2 mg weekly
biomarker_changes: HbA1c LS mean change: exenatide -0.87% vs placebo +0.08% (p=0.0013)
FPG LS mean change: exenatide -32 mg/dL vs placebo +8 mg/dL (p=0.0035)
Body weight LS mean change: exenatide -1.41 kg vs placebo -0.39 kg (p=0.2285, NS)
9/23 exenatide vs 1/12 placebo achieved HbA1c ≤6.5% at Week 12
14/23 exenatide vs 2/12 placebo achieved HbA1c <7% at Week 12 (p=0.0033)
Antibody titers to exenatide developed in both cohorts; geometric mean titer at last visit: Cohort 1 202.6, Cohort 2 625.0
subgroup_findings: 22/23 exenatide patients and 12/12 placebo patients had baseline HbA1c ≥7%
Systolic BP change: exenatide -8.4 mmHg vs placebo -1.7 mmHg in Cohort 2
Heart rate change: exenatide -5.4 bpm vs placebo -9.1 bpm in Cohort 2
safety_signals: TEAEs occurred in 26/30 Cohort 1 exenatide, 22/23 Cohort 2 exenatide, 9/12 Cohort 2 placebo participants
Injection site TEAEs: 16/30 Cohort 1, 18/23 Cohort 2 exenatide, 7/12 placebo
No withdrawals due to AEs in any arm
1 SAE (infected skin ulcer) in placebo arm
Treatment-emergent antibodies to exenatide developed in both exenatide cohorts
1 participant in Cohort 1 had glucose <50 mg/dL

dose_info.schedule: single subcutaneous injection (Cohort 1); once weekly subcutaneous injection for 12 weeks (Cohort 2)
